hero.description:
Pursuing a healthy harmony between science and life,
built on innovative medical technology.

paragraphs: INCORE is a medical device manufacturer specializing in disposable gastrointestinal endoscopic and laparoscopic instruments, veterinary endoscopic devices and dermacosmetic products, serving both the Korean and international markets.

Our journey is driven by persistent research and development. Through close collaboration with leading physicians and professors, we apply real clinical experience to not only meet but exceed the standards of the industry.
Hospitals are at the centre of everything INCORE does. With every product we develop and manufacture, we aim to give hospitals the means to care for and treat their patients at the highest level.

coreValues.desc: Our in-house research institute continuously develops next-generation endoscopic instruments and wound dressing materials in collaboration with clinical medical teams.
Every manufacturing process runs under KGMP and ISO 13485, and our products hold CE certification and medical device manufacturing licences.
From hospital devices to dermacosmetics and veterinary products, INCORE widens the scope of healthcare for both people and animals.

categories.title: GASTROINTESTINAL ENDOSCOPY
categories.desc: Disposable endoscopic instruments for biopsy, polypectomy, hemostasis and mucosal dissection.

lines: A disposable endoscopic biopsy forceps used to collect tissue samples during endoscopic procedures.
Consists of a cup, a wire and a handle, and is introduced through the working channel of the endoscope.
The rotatable cup makes lateral-wall lesions easier to reach and handle.
Available in 1.7 / 2.0 / 2.3 mm cup sizes.
Effective bite force reduces hand fatigue for the operator.
Multi-layer stamping technology captures more tissue with less force.
IC-FCN17S / 17L — ø1.7 / 1600 · 2300 mm / Oval cup / Coil sheath
IC-FCN20S / 20L — ø2.0 / 1600 · 2300 mm / Oval cup / Coil sheath
IC-FCN23S / 23L — ø2.3 / 1600 · 2300 mm / Oval cup / Coil sheath
A disposable endoscopic injection needle used to inject fluid into the mucosa or a blood vessel for hemostasis or sclerotherapy during endoscopic procedures.
The shafted opening structure keeps the needle from jamming during operation.
The needle does not bend even after repeated operation.
Less force is required when injecting fluid.
A triple-bevel needle machined to high precision.
IC-IJX2323S — soft sheath type
IC-IJ2523S — soft sheath type
A disposable resection snare used to remove polyps and tissue during endoscopic procedures.
A 1:1 wire response ratio allows delicate, precise handling.
Minimises rebound during insertion and withdrawal.
The R-processed rounded sheath tip makes insertion and withdrawal smooth.
Loop sizes from 10 mm to 30 mm.
IC-SN0210 / 0215 — Diamond / Cold
IC-SN0310 ~ 0330 — Oval / Soft
IC-SN0410 ~ 0430 — Oval / Stiff
IC-SNR series — same specifications, with rotation
A disposable endoscopic clip used for hemostasis of mucosal and submucosal sites, bleeding ulcers, polyps, arteries and colonic diverticula.
A one-piece structure, so no re-sterilisation is required.
The optimised clip design delivers superior clamping pressure.
The rotation function makes handling convenient.
The clip can be reopened to grip the bleeding site precisely.
A disposable electrosurgical knife that uses high-frequency current to incise tissue in the gastrointestinal tract during endoscopic procedures.
Cutting force is enhanced by appropriate pressure.
The surface finish of the knife limits debris sticking to the blade.
A range of knife tips comparable to premium products from other manufacturers.
IC-KNA001 — D type / 2300 mm
IC-KNA002 — D type / 1800 mm
IC-KNI001 — I type / 2300 mm
IC-KNI002 — I type / 1800 mm
A disposable endoscopic biopsy device, similar to CORE-Forcep but operating together with high-frequency current.
The upgraded cup minimises thermal damage to tissue and bleeding.
Lower electrical resistance improves cutting efficiency.

categories.title: LAPAROSCOPIC SURGERY
categories.desc: Disposable trocars, multi-channel ports, surgical smoke filters and suction-coagulation instruments.

lines: A sterile single-use medical device comprising a cannula that creates an access route for surgical instruments and a trocar that helps introduce the endoscope into the abdominal cavity.
Penetrates the abdominal wall with little force and offers a comfortable grip for the surgeon.
The bladeless tip reduces tissue damage.
Debris generated during surgery is easy to remove (8 / 10 / 12 mm types).
A double-seal structure maintains outstanding air-tightness.
The serrated cannula surface limits slippage during surgery.
2 mm — IC-TC02 (Ø2.3 / 125 mm), IC-TC02S (100 mm)
3 mm — IC-TC03 (Ø3.5 / 125 mm), IC-TC03S (100 mm)
5 mm — IC-TC05L (Ø5.9 / 140 mm), IC-TC05 (125 mm), IC-TC05S (100 mm)
A single-use device that widens the incision in laparoscopic surgery. The Port-Assay combines with the Retractor to create an instrument access route, while the Retractor expands the approach.
The port rotates, maximising convenience when connecting surgical instruments.
Fast assembly and removal between Port-Assay A and the Retractor.
A double-seal structure maintains outstanding air-tightness.
IC-SP01 — 5 mm × 1 + 12 mm × 2, 3 ports in total, height 84 / 160 mm
IC-SP04 — 5 mm × 2 + 12 mm × 2, 4 ports in total, height 84 / 160 mm
IC-SR01 — Retractor only, height 160 mm
A sterile single-use device that absorbs the harmful gas generated during surgery to protect patients and medical staff.
Connected to the valve mounted on the CORE-Trocar, harmful gas is drawn through and captured in the filter.
IC-SM02
A device that covers the surgical site and protects it from contamination. A single-use product that does not come into direct contact with the wound or the inside of the body.
A device that draws off and removes smoke, keeping the surgical field clearly visible.
The adapter is connected to the valve on the trocar; under abdominal pressure the smoke is drawn through the tube into the filter housing.
IC-SF01 — IC-FX01 + IC-SM02
IC-SF02 — IC-FX02 + IC-SM02
IC-SF03 — IC-FX03 + IC-SM02
A catheter that uses no electrical energy, intended for aspirating body fluid. It has a suction button and a release button to control the irrigation flow from the cleaning device.

A disposable hand-held electrode for electrosurgical units. It delivers high-frequency (RF) energy to generate heat at the electrode for tissue cutting, coagulation and hemostasis, while fluid is aspirated or released through the shaft to clean the surgical field.
Cutting, suction and coagulation in a single instrument.
Handle type: Gun / Trumpet
Electrode tip: Hook / Spatula / Right Angle / Curved Dissector
Shaft length: 440 / 340 / 290 mm
IC-MEG series — Gun handle, with electrode
IC-MET series — Trumpet handle, with electrode
IC-MG / IC-MT series — without electrode
A cervical hemostatic balloon that controls bleeding quickly and simply.
Made of silicone, eliminating the risk of latex allergy.
A safe, non-invasive procedure.
IC-WB02 — sheath included
IC-WB04 — without sheath

categories.title: WOUND DRESSING MATERIALS
categories.desc: Hemostatic chitosan gauze, transparent dressing film and pH-balanced hydrogel.

lines: Chitosan gauze that forms a protective film over the wound and promotes coagulation to stop bleeding.
It absorbs blood to keep the field of view clear and to help prevent infection when used in endoscopic surgery.
Designed for curved sites or areas that are difficult to cover with ordinary gauze.
Used in cervical conization in obstetrics and gynaecology and in anorectal surgery.
Round tampon — Ø3.0 cm (IC-HBC001)
Cone tampon — Ø2.7 ~ 3.3 cm (IC-HBC002)
A transparent, adhesive wound dressing film for use on skin and mucous membranes.
Formulated with high-purity hyaluronic acid as its base material.
Maintains a moist wound environment, supports tissue regeneration and protects against external factors.
A transparent gel-type wound dressing that can be used on skin and mucous membranes, including the vulvar area.
Its mildly acidic pH matches the vulvar area, helping to balance mucosal pH and creating an environment favourable to Lactobacillus.
Hyaluronic acid and alginate support wound healing on skin and mucous membranes.
It forms a permeable film that absorbs exudate, easing inflammation and moisturising at the same time.
At 20,000 cP it does not run off, making it easy to apply.
A non-sticky texture limits any feeling of discomfort.
Not a cosmetic — a licensed sterile Class 2 medical device approved for safety and efficacy.
No added preservatives.

categories.title: DERMACOSMETICS
categories.desc: The MIRALET and FEMIOLIN lines — plant-derived skincare developed on a medical device foundation.

lines: Delivers moisture from the surface through to the deeper layers of the skin.
Reinforces the skin's protective barrier.
Improves elasticity and smooths the surface of the skin.
Multi-layer hydration from the surface to the deeper layers, improving elasticity and reinforcing the skin barrier.
Improves absorption, extracted from natural plant sources.
Safe, environmentally friendly plant-derived raw materials.
Supports skin recovery and regeneration for smooth skin and an anti-ageing effect.
Preservative-free — use within 7 days of opening.
Creates an acidic pH 5.5 skin environment that limits the microorganisms behind atopic dermatitis and acne.
Forms a pH 4.7 hydrogel film that stimulates an environment for skin regeneration.
A dual coating: a pH 4.7 skin barrier and a pH 5.5 inner layer.
Lower cytotoxicity than animal-derived exosomes.
High stability, applicable to a wide range of formulations.
Approximately 130 nm in size — deep, fast absorption.
In the evening after cleansing, spray Double Mist to prepare the skin.
Apply Intensive Ampoule evenly over the face (0.7 ~ 1.0 ml per use recommended).
Spray Double Mist again during use to add moisture.
The next morning, rinse gently with water.
Developed on the basis of LACUDY — a Class 2 medical device prescribed by obstetricians and gynaecologists.
LACUDY is a wound dressing material that eases inflammation and promotes tissue regeneration, currently prescribed at dermatology clinics throughout Korea.
Building on the efficacy and safety of LACUDY, FEMIOLIN was developed as a functional cosmetic.

categories.title: VETERINARY PRODUCTS
categories.desc: Wound dressing material for pets, developed from technology proven in human care.

lines: A premium wound dressing for pets, using the high-purity hyaluronic acid that forms the base of our human products.
Helps the affected area recover faster after surgery.
Promotes regeneration in both small and large wounds.
Protects the wound, preventing secondary infection and complications.
Supports the treatment of skin conditions in pets (atopic dermatitis, pododermatitis, dermatitis).
Soothes and moisturises the skin.
